entry_points.text: PI wakeup scans local list and wakes notified entries. Bypass kicks all CPUs. IRTE binds IRQ to descriptor or detaches.
ENCLS checks SGX and paging, dispatches known leaves, faults unready guests, reports unknown leaves as unknown exits.
VMREAD trampolines preserve regs, call stage-2 handler, force fault zero and restore; one logs failing field.
L2 flush needs assist page then publishes and enables. Emergency disable clears local VMCSs. Switch tracks current and pins CPU while loading.
Feature MSR serves emulated range or handled-empty/unsupported. Compat checks virt and identical controls; enable needs assist page.
Real-mode faults try emulation then queue; machine checks handled. PF fixup reuses CPU error then injects.

exports.text: Intel PMU backend: PMC mapping, MSR policy, lifecycle, PMI, mediated ops, global control, limits.
TDX VP metadata failure reporters mark VM bugged and log class, field, status.
Nested VMCS12 offset table and count as read-mostly data.
VMX CPU table requires virtualization feature plus sentinel.

hazards.text: Refresh barred after run or during passthrough. Mediated exit clears fixed control. ECREATE snapshots to block TOCTOU.
Failed seam calls mark bugged once with log. Mirror teardown expects released key; on failure leaks page and clears pointer.
Failed TDVPS reads look like valid zero; writes only report. Forced zero loses detail. Cached host controls may diverge.
Nonzero skip after enclave warns; misconfig length untrusted. EPT page-fault intercept warns; enclave faults must reflect.
Shared from GPA high bit by depth. Attrs only SEPT-VE-disable. Missing subleaf all-ones; event notify bit 1.
Writeback allows 10000 retries. GPA chunks cap 2M; unreadable masks reserve upper leaf/subleaf ranges.

invariants.text: Fixed 0/1/2 are insts/cycles/ref-cycles; missing host code warns as zero. Guest limits capped by host with reserved hide bits.
PMI affects branches only in guest use; v2-3 freeze clears enable. Reset drops event; cleanup keeps only while enabled.
ENCLS checks align/canonical/limit; failures inject GP or page fault, host faults exit out. Augment-type leaves need SGX2.
VT to vCPU via enclosing struct. SGX defaults on with read-only launch hash. GVA reads use user privilege only at CPL3.
TDX key config runs in worker; failure is EIO plus bugged. Protected APIC checks posted state then halted-plus-IF flag.
TDX completions forward host results to guest return channel and re-enter: hypercall status and PIO counts/values.
SEPT leaves single-page; non-leaves validate then add. Updates by presence; post-populate may extend measurement.
TDVPS checks reject high halves and enforce width; failed reads give zero. Exits decoded by vector/type.
Core VMX defaults on with mostly-read storage: VPID, vNMI, EPT, unrestricted guest, nesting.
Emulate invalid state and fail on inconsistent config. PT is system mode; preemption uses mostly-read multiplier, enable and max.
VMCS12 names map to offsets via encoding conversion; 64-bit names use paired slots 4 bytes apart.
Also uses external helpers for warnings, locks, lists, MM, percpu and logging outside D07.

locks.text: Posted wakeups use per-CPU list plus spinlock across scan; nesting level allows use while scheduling out.
TDX global mutex; busy ops use MMU write plus zap-wait; track/remove need MMU write and ordered flush.
Domain mutation orders VM mutex, vCPU mutexes, slot mutex; release reverses; failure gives error pointer.
L1D selection under dedicated mutex outside early parse. VPID under spinlock; loaded VMCSs on per-CPU list.

state_machines.text: PMU refresh validates, parses version, applies caps, programs masks; v0/v1 stop early. Init builds descriptors.
Mediated entry reconciles overflow and loads fixed control; exit saves status and clears HW. Global control via VMCS field.
ECREATE copies info, translates, checks ceilings, virtual create. EINIT translates, virtual init, maps faults, updates flags.
GPA mapping advances bounded cursor, retry on transient, operand error on invalid. Domain uninit-init-runnable; VP uninit-init.
L1D accepts eligible names else EINVAL, programs under mutex. PLE window changes only via bounded grow with ceiling.
Skip advances RIP by exit length; ENCLS zero leaves RIP; shadow cleared. XFD and page-fault paths classify host, enclave, EPT.

structs.text: Branch descriptor holds records, host event and passthrough flag. Flush arg pairs VP with status; uret covers 4 MSRs.
TD holds VM plus key, state, attrs, control, zap flag. vCPU adds exit, fault, entry, module, CPU, result, cursor.
Host snapshot caches regs/selectors; shadow mirrors controls. Loaded VMCS adds regions, CPU, launched, NMI, timer, bitmap.
VMCS12 is packed stable image; TD bundle is 1024B aligned with attrs, EPT, TSC and CPUID tail.
PMU bases stride 1 min 1. ENCLS size/align pairs for operands. VMCS12 revision and size.
TDX field packs non-arch bit, class, number. VP class covers VMCS. SEPT encodes level and lifecycle state.
CR0 forces NE and clears CD/NW plus PE/PG except unrestricted. CR4 forces VMXE. Feature control and x2APIC mode defined.
